master.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, a game dress-up mannequin master. Create a clean full body game master on genuinely transparent background, same exact front view symmetric standing pose, proportions, figure position and full canvas framing as Image 1. Adult woman, arms angled gently outward, both feet flat pointing forward. Keep cream opaque strapless leotard for modest coverage, no shoes, no socks, no jewelry. Change only the head: make it a smooth elegant natural skin-tone oval mannequin face with softly modeled nose, ears, jaw; NO painted eyes, NO eyebrows, NO mouth, NO hair, NO eyelashes or makeup. These features will be separate registered game layers. Clean transparent edges without colored fringe. Output high quality fashion-game painted illustration, tall portrait 1:2 canvas, entire head to feet visible. Keep camera, lighting and anatomical landmarks identical; do not change pose. Not a product shoe illustration.
